text: Output is structured as an IA review with sections covering structure issues, navigation, and labeling
Explicitly sorts content into the four Diataxis modes (tutorial, how-to, explanation, reference) and uses that to drive the split
Names the duplicated or overlapping pairs, for example Configuration versus Configuration Reference, CLI Commands versus CLI Reference, and Troubleshooting versus FAQ versus Common Errors
Calls out the 300-line inline changelog as belonging in its own CHANGELOG file
States what stays in the README after the split, rather than only listing what leaves
Gives every extracted destination a navigation path from the README, so nothing becomes an orphan
Evaluates reachability, for example that any content is reachable in about three steps
Output includes a concrete target file or directory tree
